senses.gloss:
वैलक्ष्य वैलक्ष्य, i. e. वि-लक्ष + य, n.
 1. Absence of any characteristic.
 2. Contrariety, reverse.
 3. Contrary course to that which is usual or natural.
 --Comp.

वैल्व वैल्व, i. e. विल्व + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to the विल्व tree.
 2. Made of its wood, Man. 2, 45.
 II. n. The fruit of the विल्व tree.
